verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships a CLI, a feedback widget and a SaaS review service, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking controls. The only 'opt' language covers an admin opting into a PR-check failure threshold, which is an unrelated feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
